text_en: When we headed up the road to Bashan, King Og of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, for battle at Edrei.
text_cn: 然后我们转向巴商进发；巴商王敖格和他所有的民众出来攻击我们，在厄德勒与我们交战。

text_en: The Lord said to me, “Do not fear him, for I have handed him over to you, along with his people and his land. Do to him as you did to King Sihon of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon. ”
text_cn: 上主对我说：“你不要怕他，因为我已将他、他所有的民众和土地都交在你手中；你对待他，应如对待住在赫市朋的阿摩黎人王息红一样。”

text_en: So the Lord our God also handed over to us King Og of Bashan and all his people. We struck him down until not a single survivor was left.
text_cn: 上主我们的天主也将巴商王敖格，和他所有的民众交在我们的手中；我们击杀了他，一个也没有给他留下。

text_en: At that time we captured all his towns; there was no citadel that we did not take from them—sixty towns, the whole region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
text_cn: 同时我们占领了他所有的城邑，没有一座城不为我们所占领；巴商王敖格的国土，阿尔哥布全地区共有六十座城邑，

text_en: All these were fortress towns with high walls, double gates, and bars, besides a great many villages.
text_cn: 都是些具有高阔的城墙，安门置闩，设防的城邑；此外尚有很多无围墙的村庄。

text_en: And we utterly destroyed them, as we had done to King Sihon of Heshbon, in each city utterly destroying men, women, and children.
text_cn: 我们照毁灭律毁灭了这些城邑，有如对赫市朋王息红所做的一样，杀尽了各城中的男女和幼童，

text_en: But all the livestock and the plunder of the towns we kept as spoil for ourselves.
text_cn: 只留下了牲畜和由占领的城中所夺的财物，作我们的战利品。

text_en: So at that time we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land beyond the Jordan, from the Wadi Arnon to Mount Hermon
text_cn: 这样，我们在那时，由这两个阿摩黎人王的手中，夺得了约但河东岸的土地，自阿尔农河直到赫尔孟山。

text_en: (the Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, while the Amorites call it Senir),
text_cn: 【漆冬人称赫尔孟为息尔翁；阿摩黎人则称之为色尼尔】。

text_en: all the towns of the tableland, the whole of Gilead, and all of Bashan, as far as Salecah and Edrei, towns of Og’s kingdom in Bashan.
text_cn: 即夺得了高原上所有的城邑，全基肋阿得和全巴商，直到撒耳加和厄德勒：这都是巴商王敖格国土内的城邑。

text_en: (Now only King Og of Bashan was left of the remnant of the Rephaim. In fact his bed, an iron bed, can still be seen in Rabbah of the Ammonites. By the common cubit it is nine cubits long and four cubits wide. )
text_cn: 【巴商王敖格是勒法因人遗族中仅存的人物；他的床是铁做的，以人肘为度，长九肘，宽四肘，尚存在阿孟子民的辣巴城里】。

text_en: As for the land that we took possession of at that time, I gave to the Reubenites and Gadites the territory north of Aroer, that is on the edge of the Wadi Arnon, as well as half the hill country of Gilead with its towns,
text_cn: 我由我们那时所占领的土地中，将阿尔农河边的阿洛厄尔以北的地方，基肋阿得山地的一半和境内的城邑，给了勒乌本人和加得人；

text_en: and I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh the rest of Gilead and all of Bashan, Og’s kingdom. (The whole region of Argob: all that portion of Bashan used to be called a land of Rephaim;
text_cn: 基肋阿得其余的地方和全巴商，即敖格的国土，给了默纳协半个支派。【人称阿尔哥布全地区，即全巴商，为“勒法因人地”。

text_en: Jair the Manassite acquired the whole region of Argob as far as the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and he named them—that is, Bashan—after himself, Havvoth-jair, as it is to this day. )
text_cn: 默纳协的儿子雅依尔，占领了阿尔哥布全地区，直到革叔尔人和玛阿加人的边界，遂按自己的名字称那地为“哈沃特雅依尔”，直到今日】。

text_en: To Machir I gave Gilead.
text_cn: 我又将基肋阿得给了玛基尔。

text_en: And to the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave the territory from Gilead as far as the Wadi Arnon, with the middle of the wadi as a boundary, and up to the Jabbok, the wadi being boundary of the Ammonites;
text_cn: 由基肋阿得到阿尔农河，以河中心为边界，直到雅波克河，即阿孟人的边界，我将那一带地方给了勒乌本人和加得人；

text_en: the Arabah also, with the Jordan and its banks, from Chinnereth down to the sea of the Arabah, the Dead Sea, with the lower slopes of Pisgah on the east.
text_cn: 还有阿辣巴荒野，以约但河为界，从基乃勒特直到阿辣巴海，即直到东面靠近丕斯加山坡的盐海一带地方。

text_en: At that time, I charged you as follows: “Although the Lord your God has given you this land to occupy, all your troops shall cross over armed as the vanguard of your Israelite kin.
text_cn: 那时我吩咐你们说： “上主你们的天主，将这地赐给了你们作产业，但你们所有战士，应武装起来，走在你们兄弟以色列子民前面，

text_en: Only your wives, your children, and your livestock—I know that you have much livestock—shall stay behind in the towns that I have given to you.
text_cn: 只有你们的妇孺和牲畜，──我知道你们有很多牲畜──可留在我给你们的城内，

text_en: When the Lord gives rest to your kindred, as to you, and they too have occupied the land that the Lord your God is giving them beyond the Jordan, then each of you may return to the property that I have given to you. ”
text_cn: 直到上主使你们的兄弟如你们一样有了安身之处，等他们也占领了，上主你们的天主赐给他们的约但河西的地方，那时你们各人才可回到我给你们为产业的地方。

text_en: And I charged Joshua as well at that time, saying: “Your own eyes have seen everything that the Lord your God has done to these two kings; so the Lord will do to all the kingdoms into which you are about to cross.
text_cn: 同时我也吩咐若苏厄说：你亲眼看见了，上主你们的天主对这两个国王所做的一切；上主必同样对待你要过河去攻击的一切王国。

text_en: Do not fear them, for it is the Lord your God who fights for you. ”
text_cn: 不要怕他们，因为上主你们的天主要替你们作战。”

text_en: At that time, too, I entreated the Lord , saying:
text_cn: 那时我哀求天主说：

text_en: “O Lord God , you have only begun to show your servant your greatness and your might; what god in heaven or on earth can perform deeds and mighty acts like yours!
text_cn: “我主，上主！你已开始向你的仆人显示你的伟大和你有力的手臂，天上地下有哪个神能作你所作的工作，行你所行的奇事？

text_en: Let me cross over to see the good land beyond the Jordan, that good hill country and the Lebanon. ”
text_cn: 求你让我过去，得见约但河西的肥美土地，那壮丽的山岭和黎巴嫩。”

text_en: But the Lord was angry with me on your account and would not heed me. The Lord said to me, “Enough from you! Never speak to me of this matter again!
text_cn: 但是上主为了你们的缘故对我发怒，没有俯听我，且对我说，“罢了！不要对我再提这事。

text_en: Go up to the top of Pisgah and look around you to the west, to the north, to the south, and to the east. Look well, for you shall not cross over this Jordan.
text_cn: 你上丕斯加山顶去，举目向东西南北，好好观看，因为你不能过这约但河。

text_en: But charge Joshua, and encourage and strengthen him, because it is he who shall cross over at the head of this people and who shall secure their possession of the land that you will see. ”
text_cn: 你应训示若苏厄，坚固他，鼓励他，因为他要率领这百姓过去，给他们分配你所观看的地方。”

text_en: So we remained in the valley opposite Beth-peor.
text_cn: 那时我们住在贝特培敖尔对面的山谷中。
